authority: CEO Round 122 audit — 4 final corrections before physical execution

governance_compliance.article_I: No model in measurement pipeline. Mapping explicitly stated as hypothesis.
governance_compliance.article_XXXIV: Protocol execution support only. No model refinement. Then STOP.
governance_compliance.rule_9: All analysis decisions frozen BEFORE data collection

pipeline.name: Raw data acquisition
pipeline.spec: Force (N) at >=100Hz, displacement (mm) at >=100Hz, high-speed video at >=500fps. All three time-synchronized.

pipeline.name: Preprocessing
pipeline.spec: Force and displacement resampled to common 100Hz grid. No filtering applied to raw signal. Outlier spikes >5x median absolute deviation removed and linearly interpolated (max 1% of samples).

pipeline.name: Derivative estimation
pipeline.spec: First derivative dF/ddelta via central differences on the 100Hz grid. Second derivative d2F/ddelta2 via central differences on dF/ddelta. NO smoothing or filtering applied to derivatives — raw second derivative is the signal.

pipeline.name: Curvature threshold
pipeline.spec: Signal onset = first time t_s where d2F/ddelta2 < -threshold AND persists for >= 10 consecutive samples (0.1s at 100Hz). threshold = 0.1 * max(|d2F/ddelta2|) computed over the first 10% of the force-displacement curve (undamaged regime). This adapts to sample stiffness without analyst discretion.

pipeline.name: Signal onset selection
pipeline.spec: The FIRST eligible sign change (as defined in step 4) is the signal onset. No searching for 'better' sign changes. The first one that meets the persistence and amplitude criteria is used.

pipeline.name: Fragmentation onset (camera)
pipeline.spec: Fragmentation time t_f defined by independent video review: first frame where a visible crack or fragment separation is observed. Reviewed by 2 independent observers blind to force data. If disagreement >2 frames (4ms at 500fps), a third observer adjudicates. Majority vote.

pipeline.name: Lead time calculation
pipeline.spec: lead_strain = strain(t_f) - strain(t_s). lead_time = lead_strain / 0.01 (frozen strain rate). Both reported. If t_s > t_f (signal AFTER fragmentation), lead = negative → signal FAILED for this sample.

pipeline.name: Sensor noise distinction
pipeline.spec: The persistence criterion (10 samples = 0.1s) filters single-sample noise spikes. The amplitude threshold (0.1 * max in undamaged regime) ensures the curvature change is physically significant, not measurement noise. If undamaged-regime d2F/ddelta2 has std > 0.1 * max, the sample is flagged as 'high noise' and excluded.

P0_1_endpoint_operational_definition.anti_rescue_principle: The protocol — not the analyst — controls the result. No post-hoc selection of 'better' curvature events. No adjustable smoothing. No flexible threshold. The first eligible sign change IS the signal.

K1_no_signal.definition: No eligible d2F/ddelta2 sign change before fragmentation onset
K1_no_signal.implication: No precursor detected for this sample

K2_lead_time_short.implication: Precursor exists but lead time is marginal — not practically useful but not absent

K3_no_fragmentation.implication: Sample excluded from signal analysis. Recorded as outcome.

K4_outside_domain.definition: Measured clot composition (histology) falls outside validity domain (beta >= 0.1 equivalent)
K4_outside_domain.implication: Signal may not apply to this clot type. NOT a failure of the mechanism — the claim is bounded (Article I).

ambiguous_zone.implication: Precursor detected with marginal lead time. Neither clear pass nor clear fail. Reported as intermediate.

clear_pass.implication: Precursor detected with clinically relevant lead time

P0_3_statistical_discipline.pilot_gate: >=7/10 samples in at least one measured-composition group show SIGNAL_CONFIRMED (lead_time >= 1.0s)
P0_3_statistical_discipline.interpretation: This is a SCREENING PILOT GATE, not validation. 7/10 = 70% detection rate in a pilot. This is NOT '70% validated' or '80% validated.' It means 'a precursor likely exists for this clot type.' Definitive performance estimation requires a larger study.
P0_3_statistical_discipline.binomial_probability: P(>=7/10 | p=0.5) = 0.17 (permissive by design — pilot is for signal existence, not performance)
P0_3_statistical_discipline.post_hoc_forbidden: After data collection, the gate threshold (7/10) and lead time threshold (1.0s) CANNOT be changed. If results are 6/10, the result is 6/10 — NOT 'close enough.' Per Rule 15: no silent promotion.

P0_4_model_signal_mapping_statement.explicit_statement: The computational discovery is dD/dstrain deceleration (a model-derived internal variable). The physical endpoint is force-curvature sign change (a raw observable). These are NOT the same thing. Positive physical force-curvature evidence does NOT automatically validate the simulated dD/dstrain variable. It validates only the HYPOTHESIZED OBSERVABLE PRECURSOR — that a measurable mechanical signal exists before fragmentation. The mapping between dD/dstrain and force curvature is a PREDICTION from the simulation, not an established equivalence. If the physical signal exists, the simulation's PREDICTION is supported but not proven. If the physical signal does not exist, the simulation's PREDICTION is falsified — but the underlying question (does a precursor exist?) is answered negatively regardless of the model.
P0_4_model_signal_mapping_statement.per_article_I: This distinction is critical: the physical experiment tests REALITY, not the model. The model generates a prediction. Reality is the judge.

frozen_analysis_specification.primary_endpoint: Force curvature sign change (d2F/ddelta2 < -threshold for >= 0.1s) before camera-confirmed fragmentation onset
frozen_analysis_specification.success_criterion: >=7/10 SIGNAL_CONFIRMED in at least one measured-composition group
exclusion_rules: >3/10 excluded in a group → group INCONCLUSIVE
missing_data_rules: If force data lost: sample excluded, reason recorded
If camera data lost: sample excluded, reason recorded
If histology inconclusive: sample classified as 'unknown composition' and excluded from subgroup analysis
frozen_analysis_specification.analysis_script: To be written in Python, frozen (SHA256 hash recorded) BEFORE data collection. Script reads raw force/displacement/video timestamp files, applies the 8-step pipeline, outputs: per-sample {signal_onset, fragmentation_onset, lead_strain, lead_time, classification, composition}. No manual data manipulation.
frozen_analysis_specification.camera_adjudication: 2 independent observers blind to force data. Frame-level annotation of fragmentation onset. Disagreement >2 frames → third observer. Majority vote. All observers sign a form attesting they did not see force data before annotation.

then_stop: This is the FINAL endpoint specification. No further amendments. Per CEO: 'Freeze one final machine-readable endpoint specification... and run the physical study exactly once under that protocol.' The next action is PHYSICAL EXECUTION.
